title: lobelia acutangula
intro: Lobelia acutangula, commonly known as Indian tobacco, is a plant species belonging to the Lobeliaceae family. It is valued for its potential health benefits, which include its ability to reduce inflammation and improve respiratory health, making it a useful remedy for conditions such as bronchitis and asthma. The therapeutic actions of Lobelia acutangula include its expectorant, anti-inflammatory, and antispasmodic properties, which help to relieve coughs and ease muscle spasms. The bioactive constituents of the plant include alkaloids, glycosides, and phenolic compounds, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
